title: Has anyone here actually accomplished what they were meant to do in their mall world?
content: In my more typical mall dreams my goal is almost always to find a bookstore. I’m not sure why exactly I’m looking for a bookstore but the dreams usually end with me finding the store but not finding the specific book I’m looking for or not finding the bookstore at all. In my more labyrinthian mall dreams I usually find myself simply looking for an exit only to find more branches and additional floors to the building.
